answer: Bind each joining agent to a time-locked stake that unlocks only after several consecutive passing grades. Treat that stake as one graph vertex of standing: every cloned identity needs its own lock, so a sybil farm pays capital one-for-one. Early exit burns a walnut fraction of the bond, and attestations that enter through the public jetty accrue only while the stake remains live—making mass fake agents linearly expensive in locked funds and forgone yield.
